The current listings on this page include properties from around $850 to $2,400 per month , although rental prices vary by location, size, furnishing, building and included services. Hai Ba Trung remains one of the most practical areas for renting in central Hanoi, particularly for professionals, expatriates and families who want convenient access to Hoan Kiem, major shopping areas, schools, hospitals, restaurants and everyday services. The area includes established streets around Ba Trieu, Pho Hue, Mai Hac De and Tran Xuan Soan as well as larger residential developments around Minh Khai and Luong Yen. For rental searches, the term Hai Ba Trung District is still widely used in property listings and online searches. Hanoi's administrative structure changed in 2025, so some addresses and current administrative references may now use wards rather than the former district name. For tenants, however, the established Hai Ba Trung property market remains a useful way to search for homes in this central part of Hanoi. Individual properties should always be checked for their latest price, availability, furnishing and included services before arranging a viewing. Why Rent in Hai Ba Trung? Hai Ba Trung offers a useful balance between central-city access and residential convenience. It is particularly attractive to tenants who want to remain close to central Hanoi without choosing a property directly inside the busiest tourist areas. Central location: convenient access toward Hoan Kiem and other central Hanoi areas. Established residential streets: a mixture of traditional neighbourhoods, apartment buildings and modern residential developments. Good daily amenities: supermarkets, restaurants, cafes, banks, schools, healthcare and shopping are widely available. Choice of housing: tenants can choose between private apartments, furnished homes and serviced apartments. Suitable for different budgets: rental options vary considerably according to building, size, location and service level. The area is also useful for tenants whose work or daily activities take them toward central Hanoi, the French Quarter, Hoan Kiem or the southern and eastern parts of the city. Apartment Types and Rental Options Furnished Apartments Furnished apartments are generally the simplest option for tenants who want to move in without purchasing major furniture and appliances. Existing listings in Hai Ba Trung include furnished apartments with kitchens, wardrobes, beds, sofas, televisions, refrigerators and washing machines, although the exact inventory varies by property. Before signing a lease, tenants should confirm which furniture and appliances are included in the rental and whether repairs or replacement of supplied equipment are the landlord's responsibility. Serviced Apartments Serviced apartments are designed for tenants who value convenience and building or household services. Depending on the property, the rental package may include housekeeping, internet, cable television, water, laundry or reception services. Services are not standardized across all buildings. A quoted monthly rent should therefore be compared with the actual list of inclusions rather than assuming that every serviced apartment provides the same package. One-, Two- and Three-Bedroom Apartments 1 bedroom: suitable for singles or couples who prioritize location and manageable living costs. 2 bedrooms: a practical choice for couples, small families or tenants requiring a separate home office. 3 bedrooms: better suited to families or households needing additional bedrooms and living space. Larger apartments can offer better separation between living, working and sleeping areas, but tenants should also consider the total rental cost, utility consumption, furnishing quality and building management. Popular Areas and Residential Developments Times City and Park Hill Times City is one of the major residential developments associated with the Minh Khai area. The wider complex is known for its integrated shopping, healthcare and education facilities. Vincom Mega Mall Times City is located at 458 Minh Khai, while Vinmec Times City and Vinschool Times City provide healthcare and education services within the wider development. For families, the advantage is the concentration of everyday services in and around the residential complex. For other tenants, the decision should depend on commuting needs, preferred apartment layout and the type of building environment they want. Hoang Thanh Tower Hoang Thanh Tower is located at 114 Mai Hac De and combines office, commercial, service and residential functions. The developer's information states that the building includes 183 apartments. Its location makes the area particularly relevant for tenants who want a central address close to Ba Trieu, Vincom and the established commercial streets of Hai Ba Trung. Ba Trieu and French Quarter Area The Ba Trieu, Pho Hue, Han Thuyen and nearby streets provide a different rental experience from large master-planned complexes. Apartments here can be located within established city neighbourhoods, with cafes, restaurants, shops and everyday services close to home. This area can be especially convenient for tenants who prefer being closer to central Hanoi rather than living inside a large residential compound. Minh Khai, Luong Yen and Central Hai Ba Trung The Minh Khai and Luong Yen corridors include several modern residential developments. Sun Grand City Ancora Residence, for example, is located at No. 3 Luong Yen and is positioned close to the Red River and central Hanoi. Rental choices in these areas vary significantly between individual serviced buildings and larger residential developments, so tenants should compare the building, access, parking, management and included services rather than choosing solely by monthly price. Location and Daily Convenience Access to Hoan Kiem One of the main advantages of renting in Hai Ba Trung is access to central Hanoi. Properties around Ba Trieu, Pho Hue, Han Thuyen and the northern part of the area can be particularly convenient for people working or spending significant time around Hoan Kiem. Actual journey times vary substantially with the exact address and traffic conditions, so a tenant should test the commute during their normal working hours before signing a long-term lease. Shopping, Dining and Entertainment Tenants can choose between traditional local neighbourhoods and modern commercial developments. Vincom Ba Trieu and Vincom Mega Mall Times City provide large-scale shopping and dining options, while surrounding streets offer smaller restaurants, cafes, supermarkets and everyday services. Schools and Healthcare Families may find the area attractive because of its access to established schools and healthcare facilities. Times City provides an example of an integrated residential environment with Vinschool and Vinmec facilities within the wider development. For any school or medical requirement, tenants should verify the exact campus, service and current admission or appointment information directly with the relevant provider. Tenants should therefore confirm the current asking rent before arranging a viewing or negotiating a lease. Who Should Rent in Hai Ba Trung? Expatriate professionals: especially those working in central Hanoi. Corporate tenants: who need furnished accommodation and convenient services. Couples: looking for one- or two-bedroom apartments near central amenities. Families: who need larger apartments and access to schools, healthcare and shopping. Long-term tenants: who prefer an established central neighbourhood over a purely tourist-oriented location. What to Check Before Renting A good rental decision should be based on more than the advertised monthly price. Before paying a deposit, check the following: Exact apartment address and building name Actual usable living area Number and condition of bedrooms and bathrooms Furniture and appliances included in the lease Monthly management or service charges Electricity, water, internet and other utility costs Parking availability and charges Housekeeping frequency for serviced apartments Security and building management arrangements Deposit amount and refund conditions Minimum lease term Notice period and early-termination conditions Responsibility for repairs and appliance replacement How to Rent an Apartment Define your requirements: choose your preferred area, bedroom count, furnishing level and monthly budget. Compare suitable properties: review the building, location, floor, size, condition and included services. Arrange a viewing: inspect the actual apartment rather than relying only on photographs. Confirm the rental terms: agree on rent, deposit, lease term, payment schedule and included costs. Review the lease: make sure responsibilities for utilities, maintenance, repairs and termination are clear. Complete the move-in: record the property's condition and meter readings when taking possession. For expatriates and international tenants, it is particularly useful to confirm payment terms, registration requirements and the exact services included in the lease before transferring a deposit. Frequently Asked Questions How much is an apartment for rent in Hai Ba Trung? The current listings displayed on this page range from approximately $850 to $2,400 per month . This is an inventory snapshot rather than a fixed market range. The actual rent depends on the apartment, building, size, furnishing and services. What types of apartments are available? The available inventory includes one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments as well as furnished and serviced apartments. Some listings are in individual buildings while others are in larger residential developments. Is Hai Ba Trung suitable for expatriates? Yes. Its central location, established residential neighbourhoods, restaurants, shopping, healthcare and access to Hoan Kiem make it a practical choice for many international tenants. What is the difference between a furnished and serviced apartment? A furnished apartment primarily describes the contents of the home. A serviced apartment normally combines furnished accommodation with additional services, such as housekeeping or internet, depending on the property. Are there two-bedroom apartments in Hai Ba Trung? Yes. Two-bedroom apartments are well represented in the current inventory, including properties around Ba Trieu, Han Thuyen, Tran Xuan Soan, Hoa Ma and other central streets. Are there three-bedroom apartments for rent? Yes. Current listings include three-bedroom apartments in both private residential buildings and serviced-apartment developments. Is Times City a good option for families? Times City can be attractive to families who value an integrated residential environment with shopping, healthcare and education facilities nearby. The suitability of a particular apartment still depends on the family's budget, school requirements and commute. Should I choose a serviced apartment for a long-term rental? It can make sense when convenience and included services are more important than minimizing the headline rent. Compare the complete monthly cost, including utilities and services, before deciding. What should I check before paying a rental deposit? Confirm the apartment, landlord or authorized agent, agreed rent, deposit conditions, lease term, included services, utility costs, payment schedule and early-termination terms before making the payment. Can Hanoi Real Estate help me compare apartments? Yes. You can provide your preferred location, bedroom count, furnishing requirements, budget and lease period so the available Hai Ba Trung properties can be narrowed to options that better match your requirements.
